description: Looking at an A/B test before it ends needs a stricter threshold per look, or false positives balloon. Returns the two-sided z boundary per look of a group-sequential design, Pocock or O'Brien-Fleming: equally spaced `looks`, or arbitrary `informationFractions` (Lan-DeMets alpha spending). Stop at look k only if |z| ≥ its boundary.

informationFractions.description: Share of the planned sample at each look, increasing, e.g. [0.3,0.55,1]

looks.description: Equally spaced looks, final one included

name: abtest_sequential
